title: Smooth Edge Masking & Active Live Polling
author: Cold Winters Lead
summary: Added dynamic section headers for changelogs and smooth right-to-left sidebar edge fading.
changes: Added group section headers in news.json drawer renderer.
Fixed background active polling with cache-busting timestamp queries.
Implemented seamless CSS mask gradient text wiping.
fullArticle: This release updates our sidebar animation logic to use CSS linear gradient masks for smooth text clipping, while standardizing section formatting for all news updates.

title: Pure White Theme & Unread Notification Logic
author: Cold Winters Dev Team
summary: Switched navigation icon active highlights to pure white and integrated local read tracking.
changes: Standardized nav highlights to pure white.
Refined icon proportions and tooltip animations.
fullArticle: We overhauled the layout based on community feedback. Standard navigation tabs now feature high-contrast pure white highlights, and clicking any news item opens its full article modal view.
